title: DinoAI
tagline: The Dinosaurs are back! They shapeshifted into NFTs with superior intelligence and new tools. They are getting ready to compete with other Great PredaTors (GPTs) once more!
description:
DinoAI aims to create enhanced NFTs that will play the role of AI assistants.
The NFTs will contain the specification and the content (or reference to the content) that they need to perform their predefined role. LLMs will be accessed through TEEs to provide answers to user input.
The goal is to create a decentralised and open platform for anyone to create and monetise their AI assistants.
how_its_made:
This project is using the infrastructure of Galadriel AI to access LLMs through TEEs, and standard solidity and NFT contracts. On the front-end, it is nextjs with typescript and react, ethers.js.
I have been experimenting/building with scaffold-eth and the NFT mint project from build guild, and the examples from Galadriel AI.
